status_alias_evidence: Monday status label index 4 carried 'Ready To Sent' (2026-02-02..2026-05-12), 'ready to sent' (2026-05-12..2026-06-07) and 'Ready To Send' (2026-06-07..) in consecutive, non-overlapping periods; index 13 carried 'Creat File' once (2026-02-18) then 'Create File'. Reused indexes (8 Uploading -> Captions Revisions, 10 Coloring -> Captions In Progress, 12 Downloaded -> Ready For Review, 14 Editing Now -> Waiting For Captions) are NOT aliased. unmapped_status_policy: an entry into a mapped status is kept with the unmapped or cleared previous label preserved raw and from_status null; transitions into unmapped labels are quarantined (UNKNOWN_STATUS) and a cycle whose window (item's first status event through Ready For Approval) contains one is excluded from speed and deadline metrics; transitions into a cleared status are quarantined as STATUS_CLEARED and flagged only

editor_attribution.label_name_guard: an observation resolves only when the Editor Name label name recorded in the Monday log equals one of the entry's label_names; Monday reuses label IDs for different people (label 5 Ahmed->Anas, 7 Mans->Martin, 9 Michael->Ibrahim, 11 New->Refaat)
editor_attribution.changes_from_v1_0: label 6 display_name 'Synthetic Editor' corrected to the Monday label name 'Will' (the only name label 6 has carried in every observation 2026-03-14..2026-09-27); label_names guard added; no editor added or removed
editor_attribution.unverified_labels: Editor Name labels 1, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11 remain unmapped: no authoritative Monday evidence links a label to a person or to the Editor role (users have no titles or teams; labels are free dropdown text and some were reused)
editor_attribution.historical_coverage: projects without an Editor Name observation at or before Ready For Approval (the column logs from 2026-03-14) stay excluded; the current value is never applied retroactively (approved 2026-09-28)

video_type_cohorts.historical_label_names_evidence: Video Type activity logs 2026-02..2026-09 show the same label ID under an earlier name (ID 6 'Short' then 'Simple Short'; ID 7 'Video' then 'Video (Less Than 1 min)'; ID 17 'SUPER A CLASS' then 'SUPER CLASS A'). Former names are accepted only together with the matching ID, never for text-only resolution ('Video' is now label ID 12).
video_type_cohorts.source_evidence: Monday column dropdown_mm062ga0 settings_str (labels and deactivated_labels), read-only query 2026-09-28; see docs/evidence/VIDEO-TYPE-AUDIT.md
video_type_cohorts.label_text_policy: verbatim Monday label text; one canonical ID per Monday label ID; no merging of similar names

classification.status: approved by Waset management 2026-09-28 (initial V1 classification): base Class A(4), Class B(5), Simple Short(6), Class A+(8), Premium Short(27); modifiers 2*(10), Ai(16); every other label unclassified
classification.benchmark_eligibility: a cohort (exact full set) is benchmark-eligible only when every label ID is a confirmed base or modifier and at least one is a confirmed base; exact combinations stay distinct cohorts

source_board.evidence: read-only Monday columns query 2026-09-28; DATA-001 scope

cycle_attributes.video_type: latest-valid-value-at-or-before-ready-for-approval: the most recent non-empty Video Type observed (creation value or column change) at or before the cycle's Ready For Approval; later changes never alter a completed cycle's cohort; skipped empty values and the chosen event are kept as evidence
cycle_attributes.cycle_selection: first-completed-in-progress-to-ready-for-approval-only; later cycles retained as evidence, never added to or replacing the first
cycle_attributes.duration: elapsed-clock-time; nights, weekends, holidays and non-working hours are not excluded
cycle_attributes.creation_values: create_pulse column_values_json is the item's first observation for each tracked column (source=create_pulse); a status present at creation is flagged INITIAL_STATUS_AT_CREATION and is not a transition

transition_roles.purpose: context-and-audit-only; the evaluated Editor always comes from the Editor Name field

rules.note: status change performed by the Editor; the revision itself is a client revision and is context only

transition_roles.shared_account_policy: never-identifies-a-person; role comes from the transition rule only

quality_labels.historical_label_names_evidence: Performance Issues activity logs show the same label IDs under earlier names without the numeric prefix; accepted only together with the same ID. See docs/evidence/REAL-001-STATUS.md.
quality_labels.occurrence_basis: a label present in the item's current Monday value (a removed label is a correction and does not count); evidence is the activity log or creation value that added it, else the item snapshot

for_bonus.status: approved by Waset management 2026-09-28: not a positive or negative quality signal in V1

quality_labels.attribution: the Editor of the item's first completed work cycle; unresolved Editor, missing cycle or unmapped label -> quarantined

deadline.delta: ready_for_approval_at - latest_requested_eta; negative is early, positive is late
deadline.requested_eta_history: all Requested ETA values observed in the ingested evidence (activity-log changes plus the current item snapshot); completeness is claimed only when ingestion metadata proves it for the item
deadline.date_only_requested_eta: excluded from early/on_time/late; reported as not_classifiable_insufficient_eta_precision; no time is ever invented
deadline.classification: early if delta_seconds < 0; on_time if delta_seconds == 0; late if delta_seconds > 0
deadline.on_time_tolerance: none; exact zero only until management defines a tolerance
deadline.current_item_snapshot: when supplied, the current Monday item value is the latest available Requested ETA; a disagreement with the latest logged value is flagged, and no timestamp or ordering is invented for it
deadline.on_time_tolerance_status: approved by Waset management 2026-09-28 (no tolerance in V1)

speed_benchmark.benchmark: descriptive historical team median of first completed cycles in the same cohort; not an SLA
speed_benchmark.below_minimum_or_unset: report observed durations and sample sizes; comparison_status insufficient_editor_sample and conclusion insufficient_sample; no faster/slower classification
speed_benchmark.team_population: all eligible Editors' first completed cycles in the same exact cohort, including the subject Editor (no leave-one-out)
speed_benchmark.median_rounding: median of durations; the mean of the two middle values is floored to whole seconds
speed_benchmark.typical_range: descriptive only: team P25-P75 of durations (linear interpolation, floored seconds); never used for a conclusion
speed_benchmark.percentage_difference: (editor median - team median) / team median x 100, rounded to 0.1; null when not benchmark-eligible
